subject.title: perf(gateway): reuse session catalog entry snapshots per request

question: Should the plugin SDK permanently expose a request-owned session-entry snapshot to all session catalog providers, with the stated non-retention lifetime contract?
rationale: The implementation crosses the public plugin boundary; the repository policy treats additive plugin API contracts as compatibility-sensitive even when existing providers remain source-compatible.

options.title: Accept the bounded SDK contract
options.body: Approve the optional snapshot parameter as the shared provider seam, provided its request-only lifetime remains documented and the failed checks and runtime proof are resolved.

options.title: Keep the data internal
options.body: Require a different gateway-to-provider seam if maintainers do not want session-entry access to become part of the external plugin SDK contract.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded SDK contract
recommendation.body: Approve the optional snapshot parameter as the shared provider seam, provided its request-only lifetime remains documented and the failed checks and runtime proof are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged and proposed work in this exact catalog optimization area supplies the strongest available ownership signal.
